scope: First evaluation of initially unseen compositions with frozen model and inputs. Group and complete action-sequence collisions were checked against prior cases. Small transfer cohort, no global structural-independence or overall accuracy claim. Before/after speech targets independently audited. All planned observations and failures retained. No Navigation, State Accuracy, Task Success or native completion claim. After inspection this cohort is regression.

plan.scope: Initially unseen nested fieldset/main/region compositions with plain, toggle and disclosure buttons, stable selected controls, repeated activation, reverse focus and inline description. New template/site/contrast and full-action groups audited against prior cases; small composition transfer study, no global structural-independence claim. Both Native profiles finish before any engine/input changes.
metrics: conditional eligible speech and all-plan match rates
plan.inputEquivalence: Independently visible unique target geometry, Native role/name/ancestors, pressed and expanded values, AXCustomContent and AXHelp. Activation beforeTarget is authored from prior state, then independently checked against the archived before AX snapshot. Missing attributes, unknown target or unsupported event remain in all planned denominators; never infer them from speech.
plan.attribution: Existing wire-request-v1 bounded-window quality check; no native speech-completion guarantee. Predict before Native collection; never feed observed speech or target corrections into predictions.
plan.failurePolicy: No engine or input changes until both browsers finish. Inspected cohort becomes regression. No Navigation or Task Success claim. Native checked-state transition observations verify speech inputs, not whole-engine State Accuracy.
plan.mainPolicy: Existing normalized Main Speech plus case/punctuation-preserving whitespace-only exact diagnostic. Help prefix classification requires actual observed AXHelp, never predicted help.
plan.fullPolicy: Literal main/hint candidate equality; candidate is not a queue scheduler. Keep missing/repeated hints distinct from main wording and preserve raw receipts.
